# EDA

```{r}

  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~ Genotype) +
  labs(title = "Cell Length Distribution by Inner vs Outer",
       y = "Cell Length") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
rootData_WT <- rootData |> filter(Genotype == "WT")

ggplot(rootData_WT, aes(x = Midline, y = Length, 
                        color = side, group = interaction(root, side))) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ root, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Cell Length Along Midline – Wild Type Roots",
    x = "Distance Along Midline",
    y = "Cell Length",
    color = "Side"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

Logistic

```{r}
logis_smooth <- function(df) {
  ggplot(
    df,
    aes(x = Midline, y = Length, color = side, group = interaction(root, side))
  ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.5) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "nls",
      formula = y ~ SSlogis(x, Asym, xmid, scal),
      method.args = list(control = nls.control(maxiter = 200, warnOnly = TRUE)),
      se = FALSE,
      size = 0.8
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ root, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      x = "Distance Along Midline",
      y = "Cell Length",
      color = "Side"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}

# Wild type
logis_smooth(rootData_WT) + ggtitle("WT: Inner vs Outer Logistic Fits for Each Root")

# Mutant
logis_smooth(rootData_MU) + ggtitle("MU: Inner vs Outer Logistic Fits for Each Root")
```

# Frequentist Model

### Fit nls with customized function

$$
\text{Length ~} A+\frac{(B-A)}{1+e^{((x_{mid} + \beta * \text{side_ind} - x)/\text{scal})}}
$$

```{r}
fpl_customized <- function(x, A, B, xmid, scal, beta, side_ind){
  xmid_eff <- xmid + beta * side_ind
  A + (B - A) / (1 + exp((xmid_eff - x) / scal))
}
```

```{r}
WT_model_output <- list()

for (root_num in unique(rootData_WT$root)) {
  curr_root <- rootData_WT |> filter(root == root_num)
  curr_root$side_ind <- ifelse(curr_root$side == "Outer", 1, 0)

  y_min <- min(curr_root$Length)
  y_max <- max(curr_root$Length)

  start_vals <- list(
    A = y_min * 0.9,
    B = y_max * 1.1,
    xmid = median(curr_root$Midline),
    scal = diff(range(curr_root$Midline)) / 4,
    beta = -50
  )

  lower_bounds <- c(A = y_min * 0.5,
                    B = y_min,
                    xmid = min(curr_root$Midline),
                    scal = diff(range(curr_root$Midline)) / 10,
                    beta = -500)

  upper_bounds <- c(A = y_max,
                    B = y_max * 2.0,
                    xmid = max(curr_root$Midline),
                    scal = diff(range(curr_root$Midline)),
                    beta = 500)

  fit <- try(
    nls(
      Length ~ fpl_customized(Midline, A, B, xmid, scal, beta, side_ind),
      data = curr_root,
      start = start_vals,
      algorithm = "port",
      lower = lower_bounds,
      upper = upper_bounds,
      control = nls.control(maxiter = 1000, warnOnly = TRUE, minFactor = 1e-10)
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  if (!inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    WT_model_output[[paste0("root_", root_num)]] <- fit
  } else {
    message(paste("Model failed for root", root_num))
  }
}
```

```{r}
WT_results <- data.frame(
  root = character(),
  A = numeric(),
  B = numeric(),
  xmid = numeric(),
  scal = numeric(),
  beta = numeric(),
  beta_p = numeric(),
  beta_sig = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(name in names(WT_model_output)){
  model <- WT_model_output[[name]]
  
  coef_info <- tidy(model)
  beta_row <- coef_info[coef_info$term == "beta", ]

  WT_results <- rbind(
    WT_results,
    data.frame(
      root = name,
      A = coef(model)["A"],
      B = coef(model)["B"],
      xmid = coef(model)["xmid"],
      scal = coef(model)["scal"],
      beta = coef(model)["beta"],
      beta_p = beta_row$p.value,
      beta_sig = ifelse(beta_row$p.value < 0.05, "*", "ns")
    )
  )
}

kable(WT_results, digits = 5, caption = "Wild Type Logistic Model Results")
```

### Evaluation

```{r}
WT_residuals <- data.frame()

for (name in names(WT_model_output)) {
  model <- WT_model_output[[name]]
  root_label <- str_replace(name, "root_", "")
    curr_data <- rootData_WT |> filter(root == root_label)
  
  curr_data <- curr_data |>
    mutate(
      Fitted = fitted(model),
      Residuals = resid(model)
    )
  
  WT_residuals <- bind_rows(WT_residuals, curr_data)
}
```

```{r}
ggplot(WT_residuals, aes(x = Fitted, y = Residuals, color = side)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Residuals vs Fitted (WT)", x = "Fitted Cell Length", y = "Residuals") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(WT_residuals, aes(x = Midline, y = Residuals, color = side)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Residuals vs Midline (WT)", x = "Distance Along Midline", y = "Residuals") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(WT_residuals, aes(x = Fitted, y = Residuals, color = side)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ root, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "Residuals vs Fitted by Root (WT)", x = "Fitted Length", y = "Residuals") +
  theme_minimal()
```
